sources.title: Arabic Emotion Detection Datasets (Ekman 6 + None) - Zenodo
sources.snippet: This repository releases two Arabic emotion detection datasets introduced in the paper: Benchmarking Arabic Emotion Detection: Transformers Evaluation Using a Unified Dataset Both datasets are based on Ekman's six basic emotions — Anger, Disgust, Fear, Joy, Sadness, Surprise —extended with a None category for texts without an expressed emotion.

sources.snippet: The results show that accurate multi-label emotion classification is still insufficient even for high-resource languages such as English, and there is a large gap between the performance of high-resource and low-resource languages. The results also show varying performance levels depending on the language and model type.
